methods.browserZoom: Chromium chrome.tabs.setZoom(...,2) in an isolated temporary extension/profile; confirmed window.innerWidth=640 and devicePixelRatio=2 at a 1280-pixel window. Not CSS zoom or pinch scaling.
methods.keyboard: Native Playwright key presses for Tab, Enter, ArrowRight and Escape; footer focus starts with locator.focus().
methods.accessibility: Browser accessible link names and inherited language; no real screenreader run.
methods.hosting: Python static server serving dist; no provider accounts or deployed hosting inspected.
methods.screenshots: Footer and 200% root-font screenshots were visually inspected. Headless Chromium produced blank compositor captures after native browser zoom; those captures were discarded. Native zoom acceptance uses DOM layout measurements, confirmed zoom factor, CSS viewport size, devicePixelRatio and link assertions.
